STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HOMETOWN_MEMORY.title: Memories of Home
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HOMETOWN_MEMORY.pages.I:
A verdant meadow stretches before you. It has been a long time since you saw scenery like this, so you decide to make camp and rest a while.
You left Fontaine for the Spire some time ago, and you cannot help missing the sights of home. You close your eyes, and what appears in your mind is...
Remove a card from your deck.
Remove two cards from your deck. Add a [Guilty] to your deck.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HOMETOWN_MEMORY.pages.S:
You recall Fontaine's bright sunshine, the glittering sea, and the seabirds wheeling overhead.
Your body and mind relax without your noticing, as if fatigue and worry had drained away.
When you open your eyes again, the fire has gone out. You shoulder your pack and continue your journey.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HOMETOWN_MEMORY.pages.O:
You recall Fontaine's torrential rain. You think of that unsympathetic Chief Justice, of your father, of yourself weeping at his graveside.
Looking back, without your father you would long ago have been drawn into the whirlpool of intrigue and ground to dust.
When you open your eyes again, the fire has gone out. You shoulder your pack and continue your journey.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_FOREIGN_BALL.title: Ball of Foreigners
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_FOREIGN_BALL.pages.INIT:
You enter a magnificent hall filled with lavishly dressed dancers, and they grow excited at your arrival.
"Look, a new friend! Come, let us dance together!"
Faced with their warm invitation, you decide to...
Transform a card in your deck.
Heal {Heal} HP and gain a random potion.
Lose {GiftGold} gold. Gain a Common relic.
You do not have enough gold.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_FOREIGN_BALL.pages.DANC:
You gladly accept and join the glittering dance floor.
Amid the clinking of glasses you lose track of time, moving to the beat until you are thoroughly spent.
It has been ages since you danced this freely. You bid the foreigners farewell and set out again.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_FOREIGN_BALL.pages.FEAS:
You stay for the banquet. Dish after fragrant dish arrives, and you raise your glass with the crowd.
Your belly full and spirits lifted, you set out once more.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_FOREIGN_BALL.pages.GIFT:
You offer your gold as a courtesy gift. The crowd marvels at your generosity and produces return gifts one after another.
Amid their cheers and laughter you gather the presents and set out once more.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HEAVY_RAIN.title: Torrential Rain
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HEAVY_RAIN.pages.INITIA:
What a downpour! Even in Fontaine you rarely saw rain this heavy.
There is no telling when it will let up... press on through the rain, or rest and wait it out?
A random card is removed from your deck.
Gain a Common relic. Add a [Poor Sleep] to your deck.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HEAVY_RAIN.pages.PRESS_:
Time is money! That has always been the Spina di Rosula's creed. You press on through the rain — besides, you have an umbrella.
Sadly, in the deluge some of your luggage seems to have been swept away, never to be recovered.
But a Spina di Rosula president never mourns what is lost — eyes on the future!
You dry your clothes and yourself, pack up, and continue on your way.
STS2_NAVIA_EVENT_HEAVY_RAIN.pages.WAIT.d:
The Spina di Rosula never takes needless risks — that has always been your creed. You make camp and wait for the rain to ease.
The drumming of night rain on the water keeps you from sleep, and the blanket never lies flat — ouch! What poked you?
Why, it is a small box! A happy accident indeed. You tuck it away and set out once the rain stops.
Choose a card. It gains the Enchantment: Glam 1.
STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.pages.NAVIA_BREAK_BOUL:
You take aim at the boulder — and fire!
The boulder shatters under the Rosula shotgun's impact, revealing a beautiful gemstone buried at its heart!
What an unexpected find. You pocket the gem and continue your journey, light as air.
TRIAL.pages.INITIAL.options.NAVIA_REBUKE: Choose a card in your deck to remove.
TRIAL.pages.NAVIA_REBUKE.description:
Faced with the trembling prisoner, you loudly rebuke the judges for their callousness, decrying their farce of a trial.
The judges exchange looks, seemingly cowed by your audacity. They unanimously decide to pardon the prisoner and apologize for deputizing you.
Feeling inexplicably lighter, you continue your ascent.
SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.pages.INITIAL.option: Upgrade a card in your deck.
SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.pages.NAVIA_REMINISC:
Before the swirling pool you cannot help recalling all you experienced back home.
The figures of old companions surface in your mind, and you resolve to fill this journey with memories just as good.
With that thought, you continue on your way.
BUGSLAYER.pages.NAVIA_SHARE_EXPERIENCE.d:
You share many hard-won lessons about fighting monsters with the warrior before you.
Deeply moved, they untie the pack from their belt and hand it to you as a parting gift.
TEA_MASTER.pages.NAVIA_SHARE_TEA.descrip:
You share the tea snacks you carry with the elder. They praise your craftsmanship highly, declaring them worthy of their tea art.
They learn a few baking tricks from you, and in return slide a cup of tea and a small pile of coins your way.
